verdict.rationale: PostHog's experiments docs show you can create and launch experiments, define metrics from captured events (funnel, mean, ratio) or warehouse data, and read results with significance, which covers seeing which variation wins. The evidence does not explicitly mention multivariate experiments or show experiments running on feature flags. Missing for 10: explicit multivariate (more than two variants) support, a documented link between experiments and feature flags, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Create experiments, launch them, and read results with significance, replays, and exposures in view.
Any event you already capture can become a funnel, mean, or ratio metric for an experiment.
Measure revenue, subscriptions, or anything else living in a warehouse table you've synced.
